note: THE CONTROL, and the one PAREN value kg ALREADY implements: with PAREN absent both sides answer (0 "ab" nil) -- the members match, the whole match is group 0, and there is NO group 1, because the wrapper is shy. Emacs' text is "\\(?:ab?\\)" and kg's is "\\(?:ab\\|a\\)"; the contract is identical and the spelling is not, which is exactly why every case in this group asks what the regexp MATCHES.
